integrity: Two complete, independently implemented binary simplicial-chain computations are supplied; first public arXiv release of the method reference is verified as 2002-08-09. Earlier graph-classification publications are cited without inventing day-level public posting dates.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite sixteen-vertex examples; reduced F2 homology only. Neither integral homology nor homotopy type, spectral classification of all SRGs, or publication priority is asserted.
title: Mod-two neighborhood homology distinguishes the complementary Shrikhande and rook graphs
